description: Create a Google Drive folder, optionally nested under a parent folder id. Returns the new folder's id. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a new folder in Google Drive, optionally nested inside an existing parent folder id. Returns the new folder's id, which can be passed as the parent when uploading files or creating further folders, so directory structure gets built up a level at a time.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the new folder's id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the folder was created and give its id for follow-up uploads or sharing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a folder in Google Drive.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing name. gsuite.not_found: the given parent folder id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a folder name. gsuite.not_found: verify the parent id with drive_list_files. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
